presentation._comment_shadow_opacity: Stormwood's scene authors a 0.68 canopy-shadow floor for its permanent storm. WorldLook reapplies the global sun defaults after scene setup, so every phase must carry that realm-local value explicitly; Break alone returns to fully hard shadows, as the surge brief specifies.
presentation._comment_phases: F10 phase readability (WORLD 5.2, ART_DIRECTION 3.3/4, AUDIO 4.3). Each phase is nameable without HUD text from sky, light, rain and flash: Calm = soft grey-green overcast, drizzle; Building = heavier, darker, faster-moving copper-tinged ceiling, rain thickening, no strike; Break = darkest violet-slate ceiling, full rain, white-violet flash rhythm; Fading = thinning ceiling, warm afterglow horizon, rain easing. sky_* and ceiling_colour are daylight values; stormwood_surge.gd scales them by the live sky's luminance so they dim at dusk/night. fog_colour always follows sky_horizon (art.json's fog/horizon seam rule). No red: oxblood is Team Tether's.
presentation._comment_rain: Stormwood's own rain emitter (world_weather.gd builds it hidden and Meadows-sized). max_drops is the Break (amount 1.0) count; each phase's rain_amount scales it.
presentation._comment_aftermath: After the Long Storm (stormwood:long_storm_ended) WORLD 5.2 says the sky opens and Breaks become rare; ART_DIRECTION: 'after release, sky and ordinary forest colour return without erasing scars'. The aftermath Calm (2400 s) therefore drops every storm override: null sky/ambient colours leave art.json's own time-of-day sky and ambient, the ceiling is fully open, no rain, full sun. The short aftermath Building/Break/Fading keep the storm rows (a real storm still passes) with these lighter overrides.
presentation._comment_flash: Break's flash rhythm (ART_DIRECTION 3.3 'flash rhythm', 4 'white-violet lightning'). Distant flashes on their own 4-8 s timer (WORLD 5.2's strike spacing) light the ceiling and add a brief white-violet directional light; a real strike impact also calls a full-strength flash. strike_* are the impact's local light and bolt in stormwood_lightning.gd.
